result.reason: The aggregate cap is mutual and generally tracks the preferred amount, and the operative language includes most required carve-outs plus payment obligations. However, the indirect/consequential-damages exclusion remains carved out only for Section 8 rather than for all defined Excluded Claims, so indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP claims remain subject to that exclusion. Data protection and security breaches are also not expressly carved out unless Section 8 happens to cover them. In addition, changing the lookback trigger from the filing/claim date to the event giving rise to liability is unnecessary and may materially reduce the fee-based cap where a claim is delayed. The margin comment does not cure these operative-language defects.
